ἄδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;]
__1. unjust: Rom.3:5, Heb.6:10.
__2. unrighteous, wicked: Luk.16:11 18:11, Act.24:15, 1Co.6:1,9 1Pe.3:18; opposite to δίκαιος, Mat.5:45; to εὐσεβής, 2Pe.2:9; to πιστός, Luk.16:10 (Cremer, 200).
†

strongs.def: unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen
strongs.from: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1349 (δίκη)
